messages:
Sam (Marketing): Need to lock next webinar topic today. Proposal: practitioner session on 'Operational inference: balancing latency & cost' with a short live demo. Thoughts?
Priya (Events): Sounds good. Audience: infra + product. We should add TTL on recording release and capture consent in registration.
Ethan (ML Eng): I can demo a live low-latency path + a fallback quantized path. Prefer 15-20m demo slot. Flight may conflict; need backup.
Lena (Product): Add two quick customer vignettes (support, search) and a TL;DR slide with recommended config.
Alex (Infra): For live demo reserve a dedicated instance and prewarm. I'll run a pre-check 30m prior. Also we need S3 recording + captioning enabled.
Maria (Sales): Routing fields request: company_size, use_case, purchase_timeline, interested_in_dedicated. Rules: enterprise -> AE, demo request -> SDR. I can own routing.
Sam (Marketing): Great. Priya, can you add hidden tags so Sales can filter by enterprise_interest?
Priya (Events): Calendar event created: https://calendar.example.com/event/1806001111 (CalendarBot: event created). Rehearsal slots Tue 9am PT and Wed 2pm PT.
Ethan (ML Eng): I'll upload a 3-4m prerecorded fallback and the demo script 24h before dry run. Example warm command: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -d '{"prompt":"warm"}'`
Alex (Infra): AV checklist: Zoom recording to S3, mic test, whitelist demo VM, prewarm KV cache 10m before. I'll post runbook 1hr prior.
Priya (Events): Draft run-of-show:
00:00-00:05 Intro (Sam)
00:05-00:20 Demo + infra notes (Ethan)
00:20-00:30 Use-cases & ROI (Lena)
00:30-00:45 Live Q&A (panel)
00:45-00:50 CTA + lead capture (Sam)
00:50-01:00 Extended Q&A / 1:1 signups
Lena (Product): Add a 30s slide with concrete latency vs cost numbers and a one-liner recommended setup.
Sam (Marketing): Action items: I lock speakers by EOD; Maria drafts routing + follow-up template; Ethan uploads prerecorded; Alex posts AV runbook. React with :white_check_mark: when complete.
CalendarBot: Reminder set for rehearsals and tech check (auto-reminder sent).
